_comment: MP2RAGE timing used for the EPG dictionary (stage s03). Values were read once from the scanner logs/headers and are hard-coded here so that no scanner log files are needed. Times in ms, angles in degrees. TI2 = TI1 + inter-block delay.

invivo._source: In vivo MP2RAGE protocol parameters used to generate the EPG dictionary for the paper.

exvivo._source: Ex vivo scan log. Not used for the paper: no B1/T1 dictionary correction was applied ex vivo.
